policyModal.title: Corporate Recognition & Incentive Governance
policyModal.intro: This framework defines the formal guidelines governing performance-based bonuses, individual milestone rewards, and peer-to-peer recognition programs within the organization.
policyModal.sec1Text: Active team members are eligible for incentives aligned with quarterly objectives, documented merit milestones, and exceptional leadership actions verified by department management.
policyModal.sec2Text: Recognition categories encompass merit bonuses, approved overtime premiums, specialized project allowances, and organizational peer commendation badges.
policyModal.sec3Text: All monetary awards and approved overtime adjustments are seamlessly integrated into the monthly payroll disbursement following administrative sign-off.
